title_en: A Day in the Life of a Pro Gamer
note_en: 光 here is an adverb meaning "only, merely," not "light": 光有天赋是不够的 "talent alone isn't enough." The pattern 光 + condition + 不够 / 是不够的 is a common way to say "X by itself isn't enough," and it is usually followed by 还 introducing what else is needed, as in 还需要日复一日的坚持 "you also need to keep at it day after day."
